articles.title: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
articles.snippet: Backed by BBVA, BNP Paribas, and ING, Qivalis secured Dutch regulatory authorization to offer onchain euro settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: Proposed 31.4% French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
articles.snippet: Chainalysis' regional sales director in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

articles.title: Bitcoin climbs toward $84,000 after Fed’s Williams sees no rate hikes in 2027
articles.snippet: ZEC led a broad bounce among major tokens, and Korean chipmakers snapped a five-day losing streak ahead of Thursday’s U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: Organizations join forces to fight Illinois crypto tax, after 6-month pause
articles.snippet: Illinois officials already agreed to delay implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto assets, but industry-aligned organizations are pushing for summary judgment on the merits.

articles.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
articles.snippet: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“
